#!/bin/bash

# CPU Monitoring Script
# Samples CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute (12 samples)

LOG_FILE="/workspace/cpu_monitor.log"

# Write header to log file
echo "CPU Monitoring Started at $(date)" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Sample CPU usage 12 times (every 5 seconds for 1 minute)
for i in {1..12}
do
    # Get timestamp
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    
    # Get CPU usage using top command (single sample)
    CPU_USAGE=$(top -bn1 | grep "Cpu(s)" | awk '{print $2}' | sed 's/%us,//' | cut -d'.' -f1)
    
    # If top command doesn't work as expected, try alternative method
    if [ -z "$CPU_USAGE" ]; then
        CPU_USAGE=$(vmstat 1 2 | tail -1 | awk '{print 100-$15}')
    fi
    
    # Write sample to log file
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: ${CPU_USAGE}%" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    
    # Wait for 5 seconds before next sample (except for the last iteration)
    if [ $i -lt 12 ]; then
        sleep 5
    fi
done

# Write footer to log file
echo "CPU Monitoring Completed at $(date)" >> "$LOG_FILE"

#!/bin/bash

# CPU Monitoring Script
# Samples CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute (12 samples)

LOG_FILE="/tmp/mcp-workspace/cpu_monitor.log"

# Write header to log file
echo "CPU Monitoring Started at $(date)" > "$LOG_FILE"

# Sample CPU usage 12 times (every 5 seconds for 1 minute)
for i in {1..12}
do
    # Get timestamp
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    
    # Get CPU usage using top command (single sample) - simplified approach
    # Try multiple methods to get CPU usage
    if command -v top &> /dev/null; then
        CPU_USAGE=$(top -bn1 | grep "Cpu(s)" | awk '{print $2}' | cut -d'%' -f1 | cut -d'.' -f1)
    elif command -v vmstat &> /dev/null; then
        CPU_USAGE=$(vmstat 1 2 | tail -1 | awk '{print 100-$15}')
    else
        CPU_USAGE=0
    fi
    
    # If CPU_USAGE is empty, set it to 0
    if [ -z "$CPU_USAGE" ]; then
        CPU_USAGE=0
    fi
    
    # Write sample to log file
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: ${CPU_USAGE}%" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    
    # Wait for 5 seconds before next sample (except for the last iteration)
    if [ $i -lt 12 ]; then
        sleep 5
    fi
done

# Write footer to log file
echo "CPU Monitoring Completed at $(date)" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Display the contents of the log file
cat "$LOG_FILE"
